properties.description: Estimates of total number of people per grid square broken down by sex and age groupings (including 0-1 and by 5-year up to 90+) in 2025 for Malaysia, version v1. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 30 arc (approximately 1km at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are estimated number of male, female or both in each age group per grid square.
properties.coordinate_reference_system:name: EPSG:4326
properties.coordinate_reference_system:units: Geographic (uses latitude and longitude for coordinates)
properties.coordinate_reference_system:accuracy: Based on World Geodetic System 1984 ensemble (EPSG:6326), which has a limited accuracy of at best 2 meters.
